name: Auto-reclose lockout interface
summary: Prevents further automatic closing after the defined unsuccessful-reclose condition.
description: Prevents further automatic closing after the defined unsuccessful-reclose condition. A protection scheme combines measurements, decision elements and communication or trip outputs to protect a defined part of the network. A function number names a job; the scheme interface shows how that job connects to other equipment.

In a substation feeder bay, local current and voltage measurements may combine with a remote-end signal before the protection issues the assigned trip request. Backup actions use their own defined initiations and supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reclose sequence state” at the input and “Reclose lockout indication” at the output. Reset philosophy must be specified separately.
